bio.text: John Rutherford represents Florida's 5th Congressional District, is serving his fifth term in the U.S. House, and sits on the House Appropriations Committee.
He began his career in 1974 as a patrolman with the Jacksonville Sheriff's Office and was elected Sheriff of Duval County in 2003, 2007 and 2011.
He has lived in Jacksonville since 1958, attended Florida Junior College and Florida State University, and graduated from the FBI National Academy.
